title: Serino 2015 front/back peri-trunk Experiment 2
citation: Serino, A., Noel, J. P., Galli, G., Canzoneri, E., Marmaroli, P., Lissek, H., & Blanke, O. (2015). Body part-centered and full body-centered peripersonal space representations. Scientific Reports, 5, 18603.
notes: Front/back trunk mapping with sounds crossing the body. The original 16-speaker Gaussian-amplitude array is represented as the reported 1 m front-to-1 m back virtual moving-source path, with the published 372-trial Experiment 2 formula encoded for runner use.

reference_parameters.reported_trial_formula: 372 trials: [multisensory 13 distances x 2 sound directions + 3 baselines + 2 catch trials] x 12 repetitions.
reference_parameters.apparatus_recreation_policy: The physical 16-speaker Gaussian-amplitude array is treated as apparatus provenance and represented by the toolkit's linear binaural moving-source renderer using the reported 1 m front-to-1 m back path.
reference_parameters.source_timing_caveat: The article also describes 14 front/back delays for analysis; the runnable profile follows the explicit 372-trial arithmetic, representing the crossing as a 13-sample internal schedule with one shared near-body 5 cm sample.
remaining_caveats: exact original per-speaker Gaussian gain synthesis
the publication's 14-delay wording versus 13-distance trial-count arithmetic

tactile_sites: front/back trunk site (sternum/back mapped by trajectory side)

provenance.source: Scientific Reports Experiment 2 reports tactile stimulation around 5-95 cm front/back and an explicit 372-trial formula with 13 multisensory distances.
The original 16-speaker array used Gaussian per-speaker amplitude modulation; this profile recreates the reported 35 cm/s front/back path with one linear 3D renderer path.
